info.title: Hajime no Ippo: New Challenger
info.synopsis: Ippo ha difeso il titolo da Kazuki Sanada, Takamura si prepara per combattere l'incontro precedente a quello per il titolo mondiale, Date sta per ridisputare il match per il titolo mondiale, e Miyata è pronto per affrontare Arnie Gregory e strappargli il titolo di campione della federazione OPBF (letteralmente: federazione pugilistica Orientale e del Pacifico). Mentre Ippo inanellava una vittoria dopo l'altra, Miyata non ha fatto altro che rincorrerlo e vincendo questo titolo si sentirebbe finalmente al suo livello. Dopo un susseguirsi di sfidanti, tra cui una vecchia conoscenza che mai avremmo immaginato di veder combattere per il titolo, Ippo dovrà  decidere se dormire sugli allori o tenere fede alla promessa fatta a Miyata.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Miyata Ichirou wins the title of OPBF Featherweight Champion, but now Ippo feels even further from him than before. After his match, Date Eiji's second Title Match against Ricardo Martinez is officially finalized, after seven years. As they look at the boxing magazine, the coach comes in and says that Ricardo Martinez has requested a sparring match with Ippo.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Ippo comes to the sparring match against Ricardo Martinez as focused as if it were a real match, and he is determined to land at least one hit on the World champion. However, Martinez's lightning-fast lefts and instant reflexes are like nothing Ippo's ever seen. Will Ippo's Dempsey Roll work on the strongest man in the world?

episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Takamura and Ippo's next matches are finalized. Itagaki has a jarring introduction to the world of pro boxing when he fights a boxer desperate enough to cheat, and Kimura's Dragon Fish Blow can't seem to get the job done. To top it all off, Takamura has botched his weight management due to Aoki's revenge and is in no shape to fight! Can Takamura defeat the Filipino Middleweight Champion?

episodes.synopsis: Takamura attacks Hawk in a fit of anger, but Hawk effortlessly blocks his attack, stunning everyone. The Kamogawa gang reviews Hawk's previous matches and learn how terrifyingly strong he is. When Ippo and friends visit Takamura's home out of curiousity, Takamura's checkered past with his family is revealed.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Takamura resolves to reach the top of the world for the sake of his friends and for the coach. In order to do so, he must lose 20 kilos (44 lbs) before the match. Takamura starves and dehydrates himself to accomplish his goal, but will he make it through this bout of extreme weight control?

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Ippo manages to win his title defense with a 1-round KO as per his promise and rushes back to see Takamura. There, he sees all of the Japanese champions and former champions, including Eiji and Sendo,encouraging Takamura to do his best. After a flashy entrance ceremony, the long-awaited world title match finally begins!

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Takamura takes the pace at the beginning of the match, but Hawk unveils his unique style that allows him to dodge and attack simultaneously! After being caught off-guard and taking a beating in the first round, Takamura uses his speedy footwork to circle around Hawk, but Hawk outspeeds him and knocks him down. Can Takamura learn to counter Hawk's wild fighting style in time?

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: Takamura is outsped once more and knocked unconscious, but manages to recover just in time. Relying on what he has learned from the coach, he knocks down Hawk and discovers his weakness! An all-out brawl ensues and Takamura comes out on top! Takamura begins the next round with a KO proclamation - but can he really end the fight in this round?

Realizing that his pain is because of Bryan Hawk, he begins fighting back, this time driven purely by instinct and anger. Takamura turns the table, but the champion on the ropes has one last trick up his sleeve...

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: After a gruesome fight, Takamura becomes the WBC Jr. Middleweight World Champion, and orders a giant bronze statue of himself to celebrate. Itagaki wins his first official match, and Ippo meets Itagaki's family - and learns how terrifying a simple pun can be!

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: When Miyata confronts Ippo about their promise, it is revealed that Miyata has risen far above Ippo's level due to his over-reliance on the Dempsey Roll. When Ippo's next challenger, Shimabukuro Iwao, declares that he will destroy the Dempsey Roll, Ippo decides to train his Dempsey Roll so that it has no weaknesses. The coach decides to help Ippo, even if it means fighting against modern boxing itself!
